headline: Ex-Fed Official Clarida Says AI Cannot Solve U.S. Fiscal Trajectory
summary: Former Federal Reserve Vice-President Richard Clarida stated that even with advancements in artificial intelligence and potential positive economic effects, AI will not be sufficient to resolve the unsustainable U.S. fiscal path.
why: Macroeconomic assessments of national debt trajectories by former central bankers inform sovereign risk evaluations and long-term fiscal policy debates.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Persistent structural fiscal deficits pose long-term economic sustainability concerns despite technological gains.
